prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1493; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type, and the presenting symptoms are plausible for a cervical strain. Over the course of 17 visits, care progressed along a typical pathway that included manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graded activity, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Palpation and range-of-motion testing revealed findings that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and several other examination components returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region has been reported or identified in the records reviewed. Billing review noted a duplicate charge for one service on the same date; the provider acknowledged that the second entry was a repeat and has agreed to correct the account. Prognosis is favorable with continued self-directed exercise.
